traditions.WLC: בֶּן שָׁנָ֖ה שָׁא֣וּל בְּ מָלְכ֑ וֹ
traditions.VUL: Fílius uníus anni erat Saul cum regnáre cœpísset :
traditions.KJV: Saul reigned one year ;

1.english_reference: and when he had reigned two years over Israel

traditions.WLC: וּ שְׁתֵּ֣י שָׁנִ֔ים מָלַ֖ךְ עַל יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
traditions.VUL: duóbus autem annis regnávit super Israel .
traditions.KJV: and when he had reigned two years over Israel ,

2.english_reference: Saul chose him three thousand [ men ] of Israel

traditions.WLC: וַ יִּבְחַר ל֨ וֹ שָׁא֜וּל שְׁלֹ֣שֶׁת אֲלָפִים֮ מִ יִּשְׂרָאֵל֒
traditions.LXX: Καὶ ἐκλέγεται Σαοὺλ ἑαυτῷ τρεῖς χιλιάδας ἀνδρῶν ἐκ τῶν ἀνδρῶν Ἰσραήλ ·
traditions.VUL: Et elégit sibi Saul tria míllia de Israel :
traditions.KJV: Saul chose him three thousand [ men ] of Israel ; [ whereof ]

2.english_reference: [ whereof ] two thousand were with Saul in Michmash and in mount Bethel

traditions.WLC: וַ יִּהְי֨וּ עִם שָׁא֜וּל אַלְפַּ֗יִם בְּ מִכְמָשׂ֙ וּ בְ הַ֣ר בֵּֽית אֵ֔ל
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἦσαν μετὰ Σαοὺλ δισχίλιοι ἐν Μαχεμὰς καὶ ἐν τῷ ὄρει Βαιθήλ ,
traditions.VUL: et erant cum Saul duo míllia in Machmas , et in monte Bethel :
traditions.KJV: two thousand were with Saul in Michmash and in mount Bethel ,

2.english_reference: and a thousand were with Jonathan in Gibeah of Benjamin

traditions.WLC: וְ אֶ֗לֶף הָיוּ֙ עִם י֣וֹנָתָ֔ן בְּ גִבְעַ֖ת בִּנְיָמִ֑ין
traditions.LXX: χίλιοι ἦσαν μετὰ Ἰωναθὰν ἐν Γαβεὲ τοῦ Βενιαμείν ·
traditions.VUL: mille autem cum Iónatha in Gábaa Béniamin :
traditions.KJV: and a thousand were with Jonathan in Gibeah of Benjamin :

2.english_reference: and the rest of the people he sent every man to his tent

traditions.WLC: וְ יֶ֣תֶר הָ עָ֔ם שִׁלַּ֖ח אִ֥ישׁ לְ אֹהָלָֽי ו
traditions.LXX: καὶ τὸ κατάλοιπον τοῦ λαοῦ ἐξαπέστειλεν ἕκαστον εἰς τὸ σκήνωμα αὐτοῦ .
traditions.VUL: porro céterum pópulum remísit unumquémque in tabernácula sua .
traditions.KJV: and the rest of the people he sent every man to his tent .

3.english_reference: And Jonathan smote the garrison of the Philistines that [ was ] in Geba

traditions.WLC: וַ יַּ֣ךְ יוֹנָתָ֗ן אֵ֣ת נְצִ֤יב פְּלִשְׁתִּים֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בְּ גֶ֔בַע
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐπάταξεν Ἰωναθὰν τὸν Νασεὶβ τὸν ἀλλόφυλον τὸν ἐν τῷ βουνῷ ,
traditions.VUL: Et percússit Iónathas statiónem Philisthinórum , quæ erat in Gábaa .
traditions.KJV: And Jonathan smote the garrison of the Philistines that [ was ] in Geba ,

3.english_reference: and the Philistines heard [ of it ]

traditions.WLC: וַֽ יִּשְׁמְע֖וּ פְּלִשְׁתִּ֑ים
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἀκούουσιν οἱ ἀλλόφυλοι ·
traditions.VUL: Quod cum audíssent Philísthiim ,
traditions.KJV: and the Philistines heard [ of it ] .

3.english_reference: And Saul blew the trumpet throughout all the land , saying , Let the Hebrews hear

traditions.WLC: וְ שָׁאוּל֩ תָּקַ֨ע בַּ שּׁוֹפָ֤ר בְּ כָל הָ אָ֨רֶץ֙ לֵ אמֹ֔ר יִשְׁמְע֖וּ הָ עִבְרִֽים
traditions.LXX: καὶ Σαοὺλ σάλπιγγι σαλπίζει εἰς πᾶσαν τὴν γῆν λέγων Ἠθετήκασιν οἱ δοῦλοι .
traditions.VUL: Saul cécinit búccina in omni terra , dicens : Audiant Hebrǽi .
traditions.KJV: And Saul blew the trumpet throughout all the land , saying , Let the Hebrews hear .

4.english_reference: And all Israel heard say [ that ] Saul had smitten a garrison of the Philistines

traditions.WLC: וְ כָל יִשְׂרָאֵ֞ל שָׁמְע֣וּ לֵ אמֹ֗ר הִכָּ֤ה שָׁאוּל֙ אֶת נְצִ֣יב פְּלִשְׁתִּ֔ים
traditions.LXX: καὶ πᾶς Ἰσραὴλ ἤκουσεν λεγόντων Πέπαικεν Σαοὺλ τὸν Νασεὶβ τὸν ἀλλόφυλον ,
traditions.VUL: Et univérsus Israel audívit huiuscémodi famam : Percússit Saul statiónem Philisthinórum ,
traditions.KJV: And all Israel heard say [ that ] Saul had smitten a garrison of the Philistines ,

4.english_reference: and [ that ] Israel also was had in abomination with the Philistines

traditions.WLC: וְ גַם נִבְאַשׁ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל בַּ פְּלִשְׁתִּ֑ים
traditions.LXX: καὶ ᾐσχύνθησαν Ἰσραὴλ ἐν τοῖς ἀλλοφύλοις ·
traditions.VUL: et eréxit se Israel advérsus Philísthiim .
traditions.KJV: and [ that ] Israel also was had in abomination with the Philistines .

4.english_reference: And the people were called together after Saul to Gilgal

traditions.WLC: וַ יִּצָּעֲק֥וּ הָ עָ֛ם אַחֲרֵ֥י שָׁא֖וּל הַ גִּלְגָּֽל
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἀνέβησαν οἱ υἱοὶ Ἰσραὴλ ὀπίσω Σαοὺλ ἐν Γαλγάλοις .
traditions.VUL: Clamávit ergo pópulus post Saul in Gálgala .
traditions.KJV: And the people were called together after Saul to Gilgal .

5.english_reference: And the Philistines gathered themselves together to fight with Israel

traditions.WLC: וּ פְלִשְׁתִּ֞ים נֶאֶסְפ֣וּ לְ הִלָּחֵ֣ם עִם יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל
traditions.LXX: καὶ οἱ ἀλλόφυλοι συνάγονται εἰς πόλεμον ἐπὶ Ἰσραήλ ,
traditions.VUL: Et Philísthiim congregáti sunt ad prœliándum contra Israel ,
traditions.KJV: And the Philistines gathered themselves together to fight with Israel ,

5.english_reference: thirty thousand chariots , and six thousand horsemen , and people as the sand which [ is ] on the sea shore in multitude

traditions.WLC: שְׁלֹשִׁ֨ים אֶ֤לֶף רֶ֨כֶב֙ וְ שֵׁ֤שֶׁת אֲלָפִים֙ פָּרָשִׁ֔ים וְ עָ֕ם כַּ ח֛וֹל אֲשֶׁ֥ר עַל שְׂפַֽת הַ יָּ֖ם לָ רֹ֑ב
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἀναβαίνουσιν ἐπὶ Ἰσραήλ τριάκοντα χιλιάδες ἁρμάτων καὶ ἓξ χιλιάδες ἱππέων καὶ λαὸς ὡς ἡ ἄμμος ἡ παρὰ τὴν θάλασσαν τῷ πλήθει ·
traditions.VUL: trigínta míllia cúrruum , et sex míllia équitum , et réliquum vulgus , sicut aréna quæ est in líttore maris plúrima .
traditions.KJV: thirty thousand chariots , and six thousand horsemen , and people as the sand which [ is ] on the sea shore in multitude :

5.english_reference: and they came up , and pitched in Michmash , eastward from Bethaven

traditions.WLC: וַֽ יַּעֲלוּ֙ וַ יַּחֲנ֣וּ בְ מִכְמָ֔שׂ קִדְמַ֖ת בֵּ֥ית אָֽוֶן
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἀναβαίνουσιν καὶ παρεμβάλλουσιν ἐν Μαχεμὰς ἐξ ἐναντίας Βαιθωρὼν κατὰ νώτου .
traditions.VUL: Et ascendéntes castrametáti sunt in Machmas ad oriéntem Betháven .
traditions.KJV: and they came up , and pitched in Michmash , eastward from Bethaven .

6.english_reference: When the men of Israel saw that they were in a strait , ( for the people were distressed , )

traditions.WLC: וְ אִ֨ישׁ יִשְׂרָאֵ֤ל רָאוּ֙ כִּ֣י צַר ל֔ וֹ כִּ֥י נִגַּ֖שׂ הָ עָ֑ם
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἀνὴρ Ἰσραὴλ εἶδεν ὅτι στενῶς αὐτῷ μὴ προσάγειν αὐτόν ,
traditions.VUL: Quod cum vidíssent viri Israel se in arcto pósitos ( afflíctus enim erat pópulus ) ,
traditions.KJV: When the men of Israel saw that they were in a strait , ( for the people were distressed , )

6.english_reference: then the people did hide themselves in caves , and in thickets , and in rocks , and in high places , and in pits

traditions.WLC: וַ יִּֽתְחַבְּא֣וּ הָ עָ֗ם בַּ מְּעָר֤וֹת וּ בַֽ חֲוָחִים֙ וּ בַ סְּלָעִ֔ים וּ בַ צְּרִחִ֖ים וּ בַ בֹּרֽוֹת
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐκρύβη ὁ λαὸς ἐν τοῖς σπηλαίοις καὶ ἐν ταῖς μάνδραις καὶ ἐν ταῖς πέτραις καὶ ἐν τοῖς βόθροις καὶ ἐν τοῖς λάκκοις .
traditions.VUL: abscondérunt se in spelúncis , et in ábditis , in petris quoque , et in antris , et in cistérnis .
traditions.KJV: then the people did hide themselves in caves , and in thickets , and in rocks , and in high places , and in pits .

7.english_reference: And [ some of ] the Hebrews went over Jordan to the land of Gad and Gilead

traditions.WLC: וְ עִבְרִ֗ים עָֽבְרוּ֙ אֶת הַ יַּרְדֵּ֔ן אֶ֥רֶץ גָּ֖ד וְ גִלְעָ֑ד
traditions.LXX: καὶ οἱ διαβαίνοντες διέβησαν τὸν Ἰορδάνην εἰς γῆν Γὰδ καὶ Γαλαάδ ·
traditions.VUL: Hebrǽi autem transiérunt Iordánem in terram Gad et Gálaad .
traditions.KJV: And [ some of ] the Hebrews went over Jordan to the land of Gad and Gilead .

7.english_reference: As for Saul , he [ was ] yet in Gilgal

traditions.WLC: וְ שָׁאוּל֙ עוֹדֶ֣ נּוּ בַ גִּלְגָּ֔ל
traditions.LXX: καὶ Σαοὺλ ἔτι ἦν ἐν Γαλγάλοις ,
traditions.VUL: Cumque adhuc esset Saul in Gálgala ,
traditions.KJV: As for Saul , he [ was ] yet in Gilgal ,

7.english_reference: and all the people followed him trembling

traditions.WLC: וְ כָל הָ עָ֖ם חָרְד֥וּ אַחֲרָֽי ו
traditions.LXX: καὶ πᾶς ὁ λαὸς ἐξέστη ὀπίσω αὐτοῦ .
traditions.VUL: univérsus pópulus pertérritus est , qui sequebátur eum .
traditions.KJV: and all the people followed him trembling .

8.english_reference: And he tarried seven days , according to the set time that Samuel [ had appointed ]

traditions.WLC: ו ייחל שִׁבְעַ֣ת יָמִ֗ים לַ מּוֹעֵד֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר שְׁמוּאֵ֔ל
traditions.LXX: Καὶ διέλιπεν ἑπτὰ ἡμέρας τῷ μαρτυρίῳ , ὡς εἶπεν Σαμουήλ ·
traditions.VUL: Et exspectávit septem diébus iuxta plácitum Samuélis ,
traditions.KJV: And he tarried seven days , according to the set time that Samuel [ had appointed ] :

8.english_reference: but Samuel came not to Gilgal

traditions.WLC: וְ לֹא בָ֥א שְׁמוּאֵ֖ל הַ גִּלְגָּ֑ל
traditions.LXX: καὶ οὐ παρεγένετο Σαμουὴλ εἰς Γάλγαλα ,
traditions.VUL: et non venit Sámuel in Gálgala ,
traditions.KJV: but Samuel came not to Gilgal ;

8.english_reference: and the people were scattered from him

traditions.WLC: וַ יָּ֥פֶץ הָ עָ֖ם מֵ עָלָֽי ו
traditions.LXX: καὶ διεσπάρη ὁ λαὸς αὐτοῦ ἀπ᾽ αὐτοῦ .
traditions.VUL: dilapsúsque est pópulus ab eo .
traditions.KJV: and the people were scattered from him .

9.english_reference: And Saul said , Bring hither a burnt offering to me , and peace offerings

traditions.WLC: וַ יֹּ֣אמֶר שָׁא֔וּל הַגִּ֣שׁוּ אֵלַ֔ י הָ עֹלָ֖ה וְ הַ שְּׁלָמִ֑ים
traditions.LXX: καὶ εἶπεν Σαούλ Προσαγάγετε ὅπως ποιήσω ὁλοκαύτωσιν καὶ εἰρηνικάς ·
traditions.VUL: Ait ergo Saul : Afférte mihi holocáustum , et pacífica .
traditions.KJV: And Saul said , Bring hither a burnt offering to me , and peace offerings .

9.english_reference: And he offered the burnt offering

traditions.WLC: וַ יַּ֖עַל הָ עֹלָֽה
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἀνήνεγκεν τὴν ὁλοκαύτωσιν .
traditions.VUL: Et óbtulit holocáustum .
traditions.KJV: And he offered the burnt offering .

10.english_reference: And it came to pass , that as soon as he had made an end of offering the burnt offering

traditions.WLC: וַ יְהִ֗י כְּ כַלֹּת וֹ֙ לְ הַעֲל֣וֹת הָ עֹלָ֔ה
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐγένετο ὡς συνετέλεσεν ἀναφέρων τὴν ὁλοκαύτωσιν ,
traditions.VUL: Cumque complésset ófferens holocáustum ,
traditions.KJV: And it came to pass , that as soon as he had made an end of offering the burnt offering ,

traditions.WLC: וְ הִנֵּ֥ה שְׁמוּאֵ֖ל בָּ֑א
traditions.LXX: καὶ Σαμουὴλ παραγίνεται ·
traditions.VUL: ecce Sámuel veniébat :
traditions.KJV: behold , Samuel came ;

10.english_reference: and Saul went out to meet him , that he might salute him

traditions.WLC: וַ יֵּצֵ֥א שָׁא֛וּל לִ קְרָאת֖ וֹ לְ בָרֲכֽ וֹ
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐξῆλθεν Σαοὺλ εἰς ἀπάντησιν αὐτῷ εὐλογῆσαι αὐτόν .
traditions.VUL: et egréssus est Saul óbviam ei ut salutáret eum .
traditions.KJV: and Saul went out to meet him , that he might salute him .

11.english_reference: And Samuel said , What hast thou done ?

traditions.WLC: וַ יֹּ֥אמֶר שְׁמוּאֵ֖ל מֶ֣ה עָשִׂ֑יתָ
traditions.LXX: καὶ εἶπεν Σαμουήλ Τί πεποίηκας ;
traditions.VUL: Locutúsque est ad eum Sámuel : Quid fecísti ?
traditions.KJV: And Samuel said , What hast thou done ?

11.english_reference: And Saul said , Because I saw that the people were scattered from me ,

traditions.WLC: וַ יֹּ֣אמֶר שָׁא֡וּל כִּֽי רָאִיתִי֩ כִֽי נָפַ֨ץ הָ עָ֜ם מֵ עָלַ֗ י
traditions.LXX: καὶ εἶπεν Σαούλ Ὅτι εἶδον ὡς διεσπάρη ὁ λαὸς ἀπ᾽ ἐμοῦ ,
traditions.VUL: Respóndit Saul : Quia vidi quod pópulus dilaberétur a me ,
traditions.KJV: And Saul said , Because I saw that the people were scattered from me ,

11.english_reference: and [ that ] thou camest not within the days appointed ,

traditions.WLC: וְ אַתָּה֙ לֹא בָ֨אתָ֙ לְ מוֹעֵ֣ד הַ יָּמִ֔ים
traditions.LXX: καὶ σὺ οὐ παρεγένου ὡς διετάξω ἐν τῷ μαρτυρίῳ τῶν ἡμερῶν ,
traditions.VUL: et tu non véneras iuxta plácitos dies ,
traditions.KJV: and [ that ] thou camest not within the days appointed ,

11.english_reference: and [ that ] the Philistines gathered themselves together at Michmash ;

traditions.WLC: וּ פְלִשְׁתִּ֖ים נֶאֱסָפִ֥ים מִכְמָֽשׂ
traditions.LXX: καὶ οἱ ἀλλόφυλοι συνήχθησαν εἰς Μαχεμάς ,
traditions.VUL: porro Philísthiim congregáti fúerant in Machmas ,
traditions.KJV: and [ that ] the Philistines gathered themselves together at Michmash ;

12.english_reference: Therefore said I , The Philistines will come down now upon me to Gilgal ,

traditions.WLC: וָ אֹמַ֗ר עַ֠תָּה יֵרְד֨וּ פְלִשְׁתִּ֤ים אֵלַ י֙ הַ גִּלְגָּ֔ל
traditions.LXX: καὶ εἶπα Νῦν καταβήσονται οἱ ἀλλόφυλοι πρὸς μὲ εἰς Γάλγαλα ,
traditions.VUL: dixi : Nunc descéndent Philísthiim ad me in Gálgala ,
traditions.KJV: Therefore said I , The Philistines will come down now upon me to Gilgal ,

12.english_reference: and I have not made supplication unto the LORD :

traditions.WLC: וּ פְנֵ֥י יְהוָ֖ה לֹ֣א חִלִּ֑יתִי
traditions.LXX: καὶ τοῦ προσώπου τοῦ κυρίου οὐκ ἐδεήθην ·
traditions.VUL: et fáciem Dómini non placávi .
traditions.KJV: and I have not made supplication unto the LORD :

12.english_reference: I forced myself therefore , and offered a burnt offering .

traditions.WLC: וָֽ אֶתְאַפַּ֔ק וָ אַעֲלֶ֖ה הָ עֹלָֽה
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐνεκρατευσάμην καὶ ἀνήνεγκα τὴν ὁλοκαύτωσιν .
traditions.VUL: Necessitáte compúlsus , óbtuli holocáustum .
traditions.KJV: I forced myself therefore , and offered a burnt offering .

13.english_reference: And Samuel said to Saul , Thou hast done foolishly :

traditions.WLC: וַ יֹּ֧אמֶר שְׁמוּאֵ֛ל אֶל שָׁא֖וּל נִסְכָּ֑לְתָּ
traditions.LXX: καὶ εἶπεν Σαμουὴλ πρὸς Σαούλ Μεματαίωταί σοι ,
traditions.VUL: Dixítque Sámuel ad Saul : Stulte egísti ,
traditions.KJV: And Samuel said to Saul , Thou hast done foolishly :

13.english_reference: thou hast not kept the commandment of the LORD thy God , which he commanded thee :

traditions.WLC: לֹ֣א שָׁמַ֗רְתָּ אֶת מִצְוַ֞ת יְהוָ֤ה אֱלֹהֶ֨י ךָ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר צִוָּ֔ ךְ
traditions.LXX: ὅτι οὐκ ἐφύλαξας τὴν ἐντολήν μου ἣν ἐνετείλατό σοι Κύριος ·
traditions.VUL: nec custodísti mandáta Dómini Dei tui , quæ præcépit tibi .
traditions.KJV: thou hast not kept the commandment of the LORD thy God , which he commanded thee :

13.english_reference: for now would the LORD have established thy kingdom upon Israel for ever .

traditions.WLC: כִּ֣י עַתָּ֗ה הֵכִ֨ין יְהוָ֧ה אֶת מַֽמְלַכְתְּ ךָ֛ אֶל יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל עַד עוֹלָֽם
traditions.LXX: ὡς νῦν ἡτοίμασεν Κύριος τὴν βασιλείαν σου ἕως αἰῶνος ἐπὶ Ἰσραήλ .
traditions.VUL: Quod si non fecísses , iam nunc præparásset Dóminus regnum tuum super Israel in sempitérnum :
traditions.KJV: for now would the LORD have established thy kingdom upon Israel for ever .

14.english_reference: But now thy kingdom shall not continue :

traditions.WLC: וְ עַתָּ֖ה מַמְלַכְתְּ ךָ֣ לֹא תָק֑וּם
traditions.LXX: καὶ νῦν ἡ βασιλεία σου οὐ στήσεται ,
traditions.VUL: sed nequáquam regnum tuum ultra consúrget .
traditions.KJV: But now thy kingdom shall not continue :

14.english_reference: the LORD hath sought him a man after his own heart ,

traditions.WLC: בִּקֵּשׁ֩ יְהוָ֨ה ל֜ וֹ אִ֣ישׁ כִּ לְבָב֗ וֹ
traditions.LXX: καὶ ζητήσει Κύριος ἑαυτῷ ἄνθρωπον κατὰ τὴν καρδίαν αὐτοῦ ,
traditions.VUL: Quæsívit Dóminus sibi virum iuxta cor suum :
traditions.KJV: the LORD hath sought him a man after his own heart ,

14.english_reference: and the LORD hath commanded him [ to be ] captain over his people ,

traditions.WLC: וַ יְצַוֵּ֨ הוּ יְהוָ֤ה לְ נָגִיד֙ עַל עַמּ֔ וֹ
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐντελεῖται Κύριος αὐτῷ εἰς ἄρχοντα ἐπὶ τὸν λαὸν αὐτοῦ ,
traditions.VUL: et præcépit ei Dóminus ut esset dux super pópulum suum ,
traditions.KJV: and the LORD hath commanded him [ to be ] captain over his people ,

14.english_reference: because thou hast not kept [ that ] which the LORD commanded thee .

traditions.WLC: כִּ֚י לֹ֣א שָׁמַ֔רְתָּ אֵ֥ת אֲשֶֽׁר צִוְּ ךָ֖ יְהוָֽה
traditions.LXX: ὅτι οὐκ ἐφύλαξας ὅ τι ἐνετείλατό σοι Κύριος .
traditions.VUL: eo quod non serváveris quæ præcépit Dóminus .
traditions.KJV: because thou hast not kept [ that ] which the LORD commanded thee .

15.english_reference: And Samuel arose , and gat him up from Gilgal unto Gibeah of Benjamin .

traditions.WLC: וַ יָּ֣קָם שְׁמוּאֵ֗ל וַ יַּ֛עַל מִן הַ גִּלְגָּ֖ל גִּבְעַ֣ת בִּנְיָמִ֑ן
traditions.LXX: Καὶ ἀνέστη Σαμουὴλ καὶ ἀπῆλθεν ἐκ Γαλγάλων εἰς ὁδὸν αὐτοῦ ·
traditions.VUL: Surréxit autem Sámuel , et ascéndit de Gálgalis in Gábaa Béniamin .
traditions.KJV: And Samuel arose , and gat him up from Gilgal unto Gibeah of Benjamin .

traditions.LXX: καὶ τὸ κατάλιμμα τοῦ λαοῦ ἀνέβη ὀπίσω Σαοὺλ εἰς ἀπάντησιν ὀπίσω τοῦ λαοῦ τοῦ πολεμιστοῦ . αὐτῶν παραγενομένων ἐκ Γαλγάλων εἰς Γαβαὰ Βενιαμείν ,
traditions.VUL: Et réliqui pópuli ascendérunt post Saul óbviam pópulo , qui expugnábant eos veniéntes de Gálgala in Gábaa , in colle Béniamin .

15.english_reference: And Saul numbered the people [ that were ] present with him , about six hundred men .

traditions.WLC: וַ יִּפְקֹ֣ד שָׁא֗וּל אֶת הָ עָם֙ הַ נִּמְצְאִ֣ים עִמּ֔ וֹ כְּ שֵׁ֥שׁ מֵא֖וֹת אִֽישׁ
traditions.LXX: ἐπεσκέψατο Σαοὺλ τὸν λαὸν τὸν εὑρεθέντα μετ᾽ αὐτοῦ ὡς ἑξακοσίους ἄνδρας .
traditions.VUL: Et recénsuit Saul pópulum , qui invénti fúerant cum eo , quasi sexcéntos viros .
traditions.KJV: And Saul numbered the people [ that were ] present with him , about six hundred men .

16.english_reference: And Saul , and Jonathan his son , and the people [ that were ] present with them , abode in Gibeah of Benjamin :

traditions.WLC: וְ שָׁא֞וּל וְ יוֹנָתָ֣ן בְּנ֗ וֹ וְ הָ עָם֙ הַ נִּמְצָ֣א עִמָּ֔ ם יֹשְׁבִ֖ים בְּ גֶ֣בַע בִּנְיָמִ֑ן
traditions.LXX: καὶ Σαοὺλ καὶ Ἰωναθάν υἱὸς αὐτοῦ καὶ ὁ λαὸς καὶ οἱ εὑρεθέντες μετ᾽ αὐτῶν ἐκάθισαν ἐν Γαβεὲ Βενιαμεὶν καὶ ἔκλαιον ,
traditions.VUL: Et Saul et Iónathas fílius eius , populúsque qui invéntus fúerat cum eis , erat in Gábaa Béniamin :
traditions.KJV: And Saul , and Jonathan his son , and the people [ that were ] present with them , abode in Gibeah of Benjamin :

16.english_reference: but the Philistines encamped in Michmash .

traditions.WLC: וּ פְלִשְׁתִּ֖ים חָנ֥וּ בְ מִכְמָֽשׂ
traditions.LXX: καὶ οἱ ἀλλόφυλοι παρεμβεβλήκεισαν εἰς Μαχεμάς .
traditions.VUL: porro Philísthiim conséderant in Machmas .
traditions.KJV: but the Philistines encamped in Michmash .

17.english_reference: And the spoilers came out of the camp of the Philistines in three companies :

traditions.WLC: וַ יֵּצֵ֧א הַ מַּשְׁחִ֛ית מִ מַּחֲנֵ֥ה פְלִשְׁתִּ֖ים שְׁלֹשָׁ֣ה רָאשִׁ֑ים
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐξῆλθεν διαφθείρων ἐξ ἀγροῦ ἀλλοφύλων τρισὶν ἀρχαῖς ·
traditions.VUL: Et egréssi sunt ad prædándum de castris Philisthinórum tres cúnei .
traditions.KJV: And the spoilers came out of the camp of the Philistines in three companies :

17.english_reference: one company turned unto the way [ that leadeth to ] Ophrah , unto the land of Shual :

traditions.WLC: הָ רֹ֨אשׁ אֶחָ֥ד יִפְנֶ֛ה אֶל דֶּ֥רֶךְ עָפְרָ֖ה אֶל אֶ֥רֶץ שׁוּעָֽל
traditions.LXX: ἡ ἀρχὴ ἡ μία ἐπιβλέπουσα ὁδὸν Γοφερὰ ἐπὶ τὴν Σωγάλ ,
traditions.VUL: Unus cúneus pergébat contra viam Ephra ad terram Sual :
traditions.KJV: one company turned unto the way [ that leadeth to ] Ophrah , unto the land of Shual :

18.english_reference: And another company turned the way [ to ] Bethhoron :

traditions.WLC: וְ הָ רֹ֤אשׁ אֶחָד֙ יִפְנֶ֔ה דֶּ֖רֶךְ בֵּ֣ית חֹר֑וֹן
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἡ μία ἀρχὴ ἐπιβλέπουσα ὁδὸν Βαιθωρών ,
traditions.VUL: porro álius ingrediebátur per viam Béthoron :
traditions.KJV: And another company turned the way [ to ] Bethhoron :

18.english_reference: and another company turned [ to ] the way of the border that looketh to the valley of Zeboim toward the wilderness .

traditions.WLC: וְ הָ רֹ֨אשׁ אֶחָ֤ד יִפְנֶה֙ דֶּ֣רֶךְ הַ גְּב֔וּל הַ נִּשְׁקָ֛ף עַל גֵּ֥י הַצְּבֹעִ֖ים הַ מִּדְבָּֽרָ ה
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἡ ἀρχὴ ἡ μία ἐπιβλέπουσα ὁδὸν Γαβεὲ τὴν εἰσκύπτουσαν ἐπὶ Γαὶ τὴν Σαμείν .
traditions.VUL: tértius autem vérterat se ad iter términi imminéntis valli Séboim contra desértum .
traditions.KJV: and another company turned [ to ] the way of the border that looketh to the valley of Zeboim toward the wilderness .

19.english_reference: Now there was no smith found throughout all the land of Israel :

traditions.WLC: וְ חָרָשׁ֙ לֹ֣א יִמָּצֵ֔א בְּ כֹ֖ל אֶ֣רֶץ יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל
traditions.LXX: καὶ τέκτων σιδήρου οὐχ εὑρίσκετο ἐν πάσῃ γῇ Ἰσραήλ ,
traditions.VUL: Porro faber ferrárius non inveniebátur in omni terra Israel :
traditions.KJV: Now there was no smith found throughout all the land of Israel :

19.english_reference: for the Philistines said , Lest the Hebrews make [ them ] swords or spears :

traditions.WLC: כִּֽי אמר פְלִשְׁתִּ֔ים פֶּ֚ן יַעֲשׂ֣וּ הָ עִבְרִ֔ים חֶ֖רֶב א֥וֹ חֲנִֽית
traditions.LXX: ὅτι εἶπον οἱ ἀλλόφυλοι Μὴ ποιήσωσιν οἱ Ἐβραῖοι ῥομφαίαν καὶ δόρυ .
traditions.VUL: cáverant enim Philísthiim , ne forte fácerent Hebrǽi gládium aut lánceam .
traditions.KJV: for the Philistines said , Lest the Hebrews make [ them ] swords or spears :

20.english_reference: But all the Israelites went down to the Philistines ,

traditions.WLC: וַ יֵּרְד֥וּ כָל יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל הַ פְּלִשְׁתִּ֑ים
traditions.LXX: καὶ κατέβαινον πᾶς Ἰσραὴλ εἰς γῆν ἀλλοφύλων
traditions.VUL: Descendébat ergo omnis Israel ad Philísthiim ,
traditions.KJV: But all the Israelites went down to the Philistines ,

20.english_reference: to sharpen every man his share , and his coulter , and his axe , and his mattock .

traditions.WLC: לִ֠ לְטוֹשׁ אִ֣ישׁ אֶת מַחֲרַשְׁתּ֤ וֹ וְ אֶת אֵת וֹ֙ וְ אֶת קַרְדֻּמּ֔ וֹ וְ אֵ֖ת מַחֲרֵשָׁתֽ וֹ
traditions.LXX: χαλκεύειν ἕκαστος τὸ θέριστρον αὐτοῦ καὶ τὸ σκεῦος , καὶ ἕκαστος τὴν ἀξίνην αὐτοῦ καὶ τὸ δρέπανον αὐτοῦ .
traditions.VUL: ut exacúeret unusquísque vómerem suum , et ligónem , et secúrim , et sárculum .
traditions.KJV: to sharpen every man his share , and his coulter , and his axe , and his mattock .

21.english_reference: Yet they had a file for the mattocks

traditions.WLC: וְֽ הָיְתָ֞ה הַ פְּצִ֣ירָה פִ֗ים לַ מַּֽחֲרֵשֹׁת֙
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἦν ὁ τρυγητὸς ἕτοιμος τοῦ θερίζειν · τὰ δὲ σκεύη ἦν τρεῖς σίκλοι εἰς τὸν ὀδόντα ,
traditions.VUL: Retúsæ ítaque erant ácies vómerum ,
traditions.KJV: Yet they had a file for the mattocks ,

traditions.WLC: וְ לָ֣ אֵתִ֔ים
traditions.LXX: καὶ τῇ ἀξίνῃ
traditions.VUL: et ligónum ,
traditions.KJV: and for the coulters ,

traditions.WLC: וְ לִ שְׁלֹ֥שׁ קִלְּשׁ֖וֹן
traditions.LXX: καὶ τῷ δρεπάνῳ
traditions.VUL: et tridéntum ,
traditions.KJV: and for the forks ,

traditions.WLC: וּ לְ הַ קַּרְדֻּמִּ֑ים
traditions.LXX: ὑπόστασις ἦν ἡ αὐτή .
traditions.VUL: et secúrium ,
traditions.KJV: and for the axes ,

traditions.WLC: וּ לְ הַצִּ֖יב הַ דָּרְבָֽן
traditions.VUL: usque ad stímulum corrigéndum .
traditions.KJV: and to sharpen the goads .

22.english_reference: So it came to pass in the day of battle

traditions.WLC: וְ הָיָה֙ בְּ י֣וֹם מִלְחֶ֔מֶת
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐγενήθη ἐν ταῖς ἡμέραις τοῦ πολέμου Μαχεμάς ,
traditions.VUL: Cumque venísset dies prœ́lii ,
traditions.KJV: So it came to pass in the day of battle ,

22.english_reference: that there was neither sword nor spear found in the hand of any of the people that [ were ] with Saul and Jonathan

traditions.WLC: וְ לֹ֨א נִמְצָ֜א חֶ֤רֶב וַ חֲנִית֙ בְּ יַ֣ד כָּל הָ עָ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר אֶת שָׁא֖וּל וְ אֶת יוֹנָתָ֑ן
traditions.LXX: καὶ οὐχ εὑρέθη ῥομφαία καὶ δόρυ ἐν χειρὶ παντὸς τοῦ λαοῦ τοῦ μετὰ Σαοὺλ καὶ μετὰ Ἰωναθάν ,
traditions.VUL: non est invéntus ensis et láncea in manu totíus pópuli , qui erat cum Saule et Iónatha ,
traditions.KJV: that there was neither sword nor spear found in the hand of any of the people that [ were ] with Saul and Jonathan :

22.english_reference: but with Saul and with Jonathan his son was there found

traditions.WLC: וַ תִּמָּצֵ֣א לְ שָׁא֔וּל וּ לְ יוֹנָתָ֖ן בְּנֽ וֹ
traditions.LXX: καὶ εὑρέθη τῷ Σαοὺλ καὶ τῷ Ἰωναθὰν υἱῷ αὐτοῦ .
traditions.VUL: excépto Saul et Iónatha fílio eius .
traditions.KJV: but with Saul and with Jonathan his son was there found .

23.english_reference: And the garrison of the Philistines went out to the passage of Michmash

traditions.WLC: וַ יֵּצֵא֙ מַצַּ֣ב פְּלִשְׁתִּ֔ים אֶֽל מַעֲבַ֖ר מִכְמָֽשׂ
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐξῆλθεν ἐξ ὑποστάσεως τῶν ἀλλοφύλων τὴν ἐν τῷ πέραν Μαχεμάς ·
traditions.VUL: Egréssa est autem státio Philísthiim , ut transcénderet in Machmas .
traditions.KJV: And the garrison of the Philistines went out to the passage of Michmash .

traditions.LXX: καὶ τῷ πατρὶ αὐτοῦ οὐκ ἀπήγγειλεν .
